title: ShareSheet has no dialog role or accessible name for the region
detail: ShareSheet's outer sheet div (`<div className="sheet" onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>`) carries none of role="dialog", aria-modal, or aria-label/aria-labelledby, even though its own close button (line 5687) does have aria-label="Close" and the visible title 'Share BadgeBudget' (line 5686) exists as plain text. This is the same gap as Settings but only on the region-level semantics, not the button.
failure: A screen-reader user tapping the Settings 'Show a QR code or send a link' button gets no announcement that a modal/dialog opened, and can navigate (swipe/Tab) into the app content behind the scrim since aria-modal is absent - the same background-leak problem as Settings, just without the extra unlabeled-button issue.
fix: Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Share BadgeBudget" to the sheet div at line 5683, consistent with FeedbackSheet/SwapsSheet in the same file.
